verified_capability_gaps.finding: No dedicated GitHub App launcher is published.
verified_capability_gaps.evidence: The approved client binding requires a dedicated launcher to validate the authorization before obtaining an installation token; merged AA4 code contains only an injected getter primitive and no App-JWT/token-exchange launcher.
verified_capability_gaps.fail_closed_effect: Do not issue an installation token.

verified_capability_gaps.finding: The live collector cannot represent the mixed source kinds in the approved CTRL-039 mapping.
verified_capability_gaps.evidence: The D5 mapping contains an HTTPS environment GET source plus contracts/bindings/aa4/aa4_d4_target_ctrl039_binding.json. collect_with_getter requires every source to be HTTP GET and routes each through the injected getter, so it cannot create the exact required CTRL-039 record without changing the approved behavior.
verified_capability_gaps.fail_closed_effect: Do not substitute, omit, or mislabel the frozen binding source.

verified_capability_gaps.finding: The persistence guard cannot seal a complete blocked run when a contract source is unavailable.
verified_capability_gaps.evidence: persist_authorized_run requires exactly thirteen evidence records and results, while build_static_candidate rejects a missing payload before an unavailable-evidence record can be formed.
verified_capability_gaps.fail_closed_effect: Do not convert an incomplete collection into a PASS, FAIL, or falsely complete run.

next_gate: Prepare an exact D5/D8 runtime-recovery candidate that adds a dedicated authorization-validating GitHub App launcher, typed HTTPS and frozen-Git-object sources, and complete fail-closed blocked-run persistence. Obtain James O'Meara's approval before implementation.
